construction: union of every test query's 65k plaintext top-3 (882 docs), then round-robin fill by next rank to 1000; rows sorted by 65k row id
queries: 300 (fever/hotpot/nq, 100 each), BGE-base with 'Represent this query for retrieval: ' prompt; NQ uses question_text
plaintext_top10_1k: exact top-10 within the 1k set, as 1k row ids
row_to_65k: row_to_65k.npy[i] = 65k FAISS row of 1k row i
